videos.title: What happens to these balloons when you open the valve?
videos.author: Veritasium
videos.description:
Take a balloon and fill it with lots of air. Take another one and fill it with less air. Now connect the two via a valve. 

What do you think will happen when you open the valve?

videos.title: The Most Dangerous Escalator In Europe
videos.author: Veritasium
videos.description:
In 2018 football fans were leaving a stadium in Rome. They boarded an escalator down to the metro. Suddenly the machine sprung a fault.

Multiple safety systems were triggered. One after another. And then the final line failed.

This is why.
